name: template-categories
description: Cascading template picker (housing type → project → apartment type) + categorised Save. Opens the plan editor, verifies the housing-type dropdown, cascades HDB → Serangoon North Vista → 4-Room and applies it, then opens the categorised Save modal and confirms its fields are present.

steps.name: verify-default-category

waitFor.store: state.floorPlan.category && state.floorPlan.category.housingType === 'HDB' && state.floorPlan.category.projectName === 'Serangoon North Vista' && state.floorPlan.category.apartmentType === '4-Room'

steps.failMessage: Default plan should be HDB › Serangoon North Vista › 4-Room

steps.name: cascade-and-apply
steps.eval: import('/src/floorplan/templates.ts').then(m => { const tree = m.templateCategoryTree(m.PLAN_TEMPLATES); const tpl = tree.get('HDB').get('Serangoon North Vista').find(t => t.category.apartmentType === '5-Room'); const a = window.__store.getState(); a.setItems([]); a.setFloorPlan(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(tpl))); }); void 0

steps.name: verify-applied-5room
steps.failMessage: Applying HDB › Serangoon North Vista › 5-Room did not load

steps.name: open-save-modal
steps.click: button[title="Save this apartment to your library (with its category)"]

steps.name: verify-save-fields
steps.failMessage: Save modal did not prompt for category (Project name field missing)
